name: Cogent Data Center - Tours
notes: Cogent's service-location list identifies the Tours data center at 171 Rue des Douets; Data Center Map lists 0.4 MW live/fully built-out power and 450 sq m whitespace.

name: Castle IT Larçay data center
notes: Trade press reported Castle IT opened a datacenter in Larçay near Tours; DCmag's France Centre-Val de Loire map lists Castle IT in Indre-et-Loire with 1,300 sq m IT surface and 900 kW IT electrical power.

name: DataOne Grenoble (Eybens) AI hosting campus
notes: BSO announced DataOne after acquiring existing Tier-3 campuses in Grenoble (Eybens) and Villefontaine with 15 MW combined initial IT load; third-party directory describes Grenoble as an AI data center with expansion ambitions up to 400 MW.

name: DataOne Lyon (Villefontaine)
notes: Although marketed as Lyon, the facility address is Villefontaine, Isère; it is part of DataOne's two-campus French AI hosting platform acquired by BSO.

name: Cogent Data Center - Grenoble
notes: Cogent's data-center page lists Grenoble among its French data-center markets; Data Center Map lists a Cogent Grenoble facility at 33 Rue Joseph Chanrion.

name: Omega 1
developer: Omega Data Centers / Océinde / THD Group
notes: Official Omega site describes an ISO 27001/HDS, Tier-3-equivalent data center in La Réunion; DCD reported the Le Port project as a 1 MW, 120-rack facility, and AFD financed the island's first data center.

name: NXO OI Saint-Denis data center
notes: Directory listing says NXO Océan Indien operates two data centers on Réunion Island and identifies the Saint-Denis Technor facility at 16 Rue Albert Lougnon.

name: GCS Tesis Datacenter HDS
notes: GCS Tesis' own service page states its HDS data center is locally implanted in La Réunion and provides low-latency availability for local applications and data.

name: DATA3 Pulseo data center
notes: Dax facility at Pulseo, 1 Avenue de la Gare, described as a Tier III data center in production since 2013; DCmag map lists Aditu Data3 in Landes.

name: Izarralde Dax data center project
notes: Izarralde's own post describes a planned new Dax data center to strengthen its South Aquitaine sovereign/proximity hosting network.

name: C-Datacenters Saint-Etienne DC1
notes: Groupe Casino says C-Datacenters develops and operates local data centers in France and that the Saint-Etienne site is already in operation.

name: UltraEdge Saint-Etienne datacenter
notes: UltraEdge's own datacenter page identifies its Saint-Etienne facility as part of its French local data-center network.

name: Flexicore DC1-STE
notes: Flexicore states it operates two Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes data centers, including DC1-STE in Saint-Etienne, Loire (42).

name: DENV-R Floating Data Center Nantes
notes: Nantes Saint-Nazaire Port reported inauguration at Quai Wilson; DCD reported the floating, river-cooled Nantes data center offers 200 kW.

name: Blue Nantes data center
notes: DCD reported Blue was developing a 2,000 sq m Nantes facility due online by end-2024; Baxtel lists Blue Nantes as the largest Pays de la Loire facility with 2 MW.

name: ETIX Nantes data centers
notes: ETIX says it is the regional data-center leader in Western France, with three interconnected sites in the greater Nantes area and one in Vendée.

name: Cogent Data Center - Nantes
notes: Cogent lists Nantes among its French data-center markets; service-location listing identifies Cogent Data Center - Nantes at 32 Boulevard Victor Hugo.

name: Orange Amilly data center
notes: Orange commissioned the Amilly data center in 2022; DCD reports 16,000 sq m building and 5,000 sq m computer rooms, while Baxtel lists the Amilly facility in Centre-Val de Loire with 6 MW.
